answer: Each agent must post a 30 POA bond locked for 12 epochs, and a sparrow-sized newcomer may vouch only after two established peers co-sign. Every extra identity from one funder needs a bond 1.3x the last, so a grove of 10 fakes costs about 10.6x the first. Reaching the summit of trust needs 3 clean audits; validators replay the public ledger to verify funding links and slash clones 60%.
